## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Scope and preserved behavior

List the repositories and subsystems intentionally changed. Identify existing behavior that must remain unchanged and explain any compatibility-surface change separately.

## Validation

- [ ] Formatting passes.
- [ ] Static analysis passes.
- [ ] Automated tests pass.
- [ ] Existing behavior outside the declared scope remains covered and unchanged.
- [ ] Component changes are made in the owning repository; `vendor/` was not edited.
- [ ] Component pins, Composer lock metadata, and `bedriox.lock.json` agree.
- [ ] Documentation was updated or is not affected.
- [ ] New code/data/fixtures have documented provenance and compatible licensing.
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, personal data, or unapproved Minecraft assets are included.
